assets.name: 마츠리의 타코야키
assets.prompt: Edit the FIRST image, an existing isolated96x64-logical-pixel Japanese matsuri stall sprite. The SECOND image is a character-design reference only, identifying the hololive member; do not add a person working at the stall. Preserve the first image's whole object silhouette, exact slightly-overhead front-facing orthographic viewpoint, counter arrangement, footprint, torn and worn materials, readability and coarse square pixel-art style. Keep all cooking goods or game equipment recognizably unchanged. Redesign only canopy palette, one large readable emblem and one or two small decorative details to make it a fan-made member-themed booth. Emblem details must read after reduction to96x64: simple chunky shapes, no fine line art. Keep it old, dusty, faded, slightly abandoned, consistent with the first image's dark outlines and restrained highlights. No scenery, no floor, no new characters, no extra booths, no text or letters, no written names, no blur, no smooth gradients, no glow. Preserve genuinely transparent RGBA background. Theme: Natsuiro Matsuri. Recolor the faded red canopy to weathered warm orange with dark navy trim and small cream festival fringe, echoing her orange/white/navy outfit. Replace the octopus canopy sign with ONE prominent cute EBIFURYAON fried-shrimp-lion mascot badge: a simple cream round lion face in a toasted orange shrimp-breading mane, dot eyes and mouth, tiny reddish-orange shrimp tail tucked to the side, not a tiger or cat. Add one small orange-and-white festival ribbon on a post. The black takoyaki griddle, round golden dumplings, sauce bottle and paper boat must remain clear. No extra faces on the counter.
